dis image has got cat looking at some past videos, 1990s new york, 2000s new york

how people use to behave, and dress, what these restaurant and shops look like, etc, overall, definitely feels like just about everyone and even every thing, has more aura?

from videos cat watched of 20 ish years ago, everyone seemed rather observant, as if their eq is pretty high, and people use to seem more unique, and seemed vastly more socializable

each person, the way they talk also seem more unique, i guess it all make sense cus we're much more on our devices, but yah

the city also use to be more dense, is another thing cat realized, saw some footage of those smaller 5 story malls in new york, the way everything was displayed, actually looks like a hongkong or tokyo mall

that tells cat that the foot traffic use to be much more significant, and that traffic of people use to be more social, more unique, and more observant

anyways, not really trying to say if one is better or worse necessarily, maybe itd be a introvert nightmare, or maybe none of us would be introverts to begin with if we were never fed devices from a young age

cat just making some observations, that people use to have way more aura
